verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a business-operations SaaS platform, so asking whether users can schedule recurring jobs or workflows is fair. However, no evidence shows any user-facing scheduler or workflow builder. The recurring items it does document (annual reports, franchise tax and sales tax filings, book reconciliation) are done-for-you services run by Firstbase, not jobs a user defines and schedules, so they are adjacent at best. The probes found no public API spec and no llms.txt, so there is no programmatic scheduling surface either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
